comparison_policy.exact_target: Require exact scientific values and binary numerical payloads for matched evaluations of identical physical parameters. NPZ compares member names,dtypes,shapes,values rather than ZIP container bytes; gzip row provenance compares decompressed payload bytes.
comparison_policy.full_complete_pair: Reuse segmented.report.strict_result then segmented.report.equivalence for unchanged existing threshold diagnostics only after both strict results and identities validate. In addition require exact equality expected for the arithmetic cache; a nonzero scientific difference must be investigated even if an existing v4 tolerance passes.
comparison_policy.invariance: Compare model/measurement/mask hashes and every point preprocessing audit. Prediction arrays require identical row_ids and sigma_m. No rerun, reweighting, altered masks or signal cleaning during analysis.
comparison_policy.objective_floor: Read initial/repeat/closure-refinement costs and later repeat-floor/refine-floor/confirmation receipts. No iterations.json before the first emitted LM record is not proof of zero evaluations. Preserve the optimizer numerical floor and freshness semantics; single sigma/logged residual values are not the actual objective.
comparison_policy.partial_prefix: For common completed evaluations compare actual objectives/prior costs, rank, parameter order/scaling, nuisance history/status, raw row provenance, full pulse reference and LM decision history exactly. Distinguish present-and-compared R payloads from same pre-release hashes recorded by trusted retention; never fabricate missing factors.
permitted_metadata_changes: Elapsed/CPU/RSS and counters/timing sidecars are measured separately
Only explicitly frozen output-root/spool path remappings may be canonicalized at declared path fields; preserve all scientific keys and numeric fields
Native PID/log/config output-path metadata is attribution data; its hashes must still be verified per run, not ignored
comparison_policy.precondition: First compare frozen scientific inputs and initialization, preprocessing/model/mask identities, source/runtime/native identities and permitted cache-only treatment difference. Refuse scientific equivalence if any non-path scientific control differs.
comparison_policy.trajectory_matching: Match point label/sequence only after physical_initial.txt, fixed_force.txt/full_pulses_um_s.txt, closure grid/state inputs and preprocessing audit agree. A shared label is insufficient. Unmatched later points are additional progress, not missing failures to discard.

unchanged_equivalence_limits.objective: absolute difference <= sum of separately measured objective floors; no newly chosen tolerance

environment_findings.campaign_entry_trap: Both numerics.protocol._execute_job and segmented.protocol._execute_job remove all ORBIT_POC_* from inherited env. An outer shell export cannot enable the cache through these unchanged entry points.
environment_findings.evidence_limit: The final fresh linearization has no nuisance-performance sidecar. Do not infer measured final-build counters from prior search iterations; source/env identity can establish intended treatment, while counter coverage remains explicit.
environment_findings.reject_contamination: Clear inherited ORBIT_POC_*, PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME and unpinned LD_* before restoring the frozen allowlist; in particular do not inherit arithmetic-audit or fixture controls. Set one numerical thread in every pinned BLAS/OpenMP implementation.
environment_findings.safe_chain: A separately supervised direct call to orbit_poc.segmented.backend.fit_job inherits explicit worker cache/performance flags. comparison.backend.run_native copies os.environ; NativeModel.evaluate overrides numerical QR controls but does not override those two cache/performance flags.

freeze_requirements: Exact original request/input/initialization/mask/model/weight/prior/hyperparameter hashes and an explicit path remapping ledger; source/runtime/binary substitutions are engineering controls and must be separately identified.

Same candidate binary, dependencies, Python source and CPU/thread settings for both attempts; balanced order fixed before inspection; independently admitted serial execution with original 7200s, 8GiB, 32 accepted iterations, 96 trials and all original stopping/closure thresholds.

Same corrected dense backend profile and diagnostic exporter identity. Pin any supplemental export native binary required by V4Model._dense_covariance_extras before launch; missing exporter is a preparation defect, not permission to omit selected covariance diagnostics.
Set cache=0 versus cache=1 and performance=1 explicitly in the actual backend worker environment after sanitation. Keep native full-fit storage settings unchanged.

Record worker environment allowlist in a signed-by-hash preparation/launch receipt; supervisor plan alone does not serialize environment. Post-run verify cache flags and positive hit coverage in completed native sidecars.
All input/source/runtime identities verified before/after outside measured fit wall time. Any missing, interrupted, failed or timed-out planned attempt retained, without retry/replacement.
no_claims: No replacement of frozen v4 attempts or its publication
No covariance authorization from nuisance-only or floor-limited progress
No warm start or reduced preprocessing introduced by this experiment

each_point: remaining qr.*.R.bin/rhs.bin; released R hashes via retention ledgers
outer: final experiment result receipt with hashes and retained failure classification
successful_fit: native preprocessing_audit, parameter covariance, phase_recovery, apriori_solution, parameter_names
all final artifacts returned by V4Model.finish and their recorded hashes

reusable_tool_limits.analyzer: analyze_nuisance_profile.py can summarize closed-fit profiles when given real compatible terminal/supervisor receipts; pure validate_performance/performance_summary helpers can validate linked sidecars. It does not establish whole-fit scientific equivalence.
reusable_tool_limits.existing_equivalence: segmented.report.equivalence requires complete state, prediction and selected cross/dynamic covariance artifacts; it does not accept partial fits. strict_result is required separately and validates unchanged final correction thresholds.
reusable_tool_limits.new_analysis_scope: Separate read-only full-fit outcome checker/summary, independently reviewed and pinned before use. No modifications to frozen controllers, existing small-pair checker, numerical backend or thresholds.
reusable_tool_limits.small_pair_checker: check_nuisance_performance_pair.py cannot directly certify these full fits: it requires its exact frozen paired-run schema, taskset5-argv profile receipt, all factors through iterations+1 and matching scientific file inventory. Full-fit run_native emits2-argv native receipts, internal retention removes R generations, and spool paths differ. Do not fabricate compatible receipts or disable retention to force it through.

scope: Separately frozen candidate executable cache-off/on repetitions of the exact original 24-hour 500km quiet normal pulse problem; no replacement of frozen campaign attempts.

authority_order: Verified terminal outer supervisor tied to frozen argv/helper/boot/plan and owned cleanup
Unique worker-result/result JSON if present and correctly attributed
Per-point and per-command receipts as partial evidence only
terminal_classification.complete: Require supervisor success/cleanup, worker status complete, converged true and covariance_valid true; call segmented.report.strict_result(result,job), verify all artifacts/hashes and final strict undamped correction. A successful exit code alone is insufficient.
terminal_classification.floor_limited: Record each valid nuisance_floor_limited point as progress only. It cannot establish full convergence or authorize covariance. All full-fit completion requires final strict nuisance status and fresh undamped correction.
terminal_classification.missing_or_running: Never pass; missing metrics are unknown, not zero. Only analyze copied/closed data whose ownership and terminal identity are established.
terminal_classification.native_failure: Preserve backend numerical_status/error and root cause separately from controller failure. Worker may exit0 with failed scientific result.
terminal_classification.timeout_or_resource_limit: Authoritative outer timeout/memory/disk/interruption overrides a partially written or apparently successful worker result. covariance_valid=false for experiment acceptance, original files preserved unchanged.

timing_policy: Report outer supervised whole-fit wall time and recursive process-tree peak RSS; native_runtime peak RSS is only maximum native parent RSS and must not be relabeled.
Report per-command/profile elapsed time, completed profile count, accepted LM/trial/rejection counts if emitted, closures/propagations if measured, and unfinished stage. Missing totals stay unknown.

Partition sidecar parent, ordinary child, zero-update replay, audit and probe categories; preserve nested build/design/interpolation timing and CPU versus wall distinctions. Do not sum overlapping measurements or claim sidecars are exhaustive.

Both complete: single paired observation only, report observed wall/RSS differences without statistical speedup claim. Both timeout: censored wall limits, no full-fit speed ratio. Off timeout/on complete: one-case completion within budget, lower-bound timing relationship only. Off complete/on failure: explicit regression requiring diagnosis. All other outcome pairs remain explicit.
